title: go-canbus JSON Lines capture record, version 1
description: One JSON object per line. An optional first line is a header; every other line is a frame. Lossless representation of github.com/otfabric/go-canbus Frame values.

timestamp.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch; written with 9 fractional digits.

id.description: Identifier without flag bits; for error frames the error class bits.

len.description: Payload length; for remote frames the requested DLC.

len8dlc.description: Raw DLC 9..15 of a classical frame with 8 bytes.

echo.description: The frame was the recording socket's own transmission.
